What this companion is

This companion edition matches the single-file app GODENGINE_V3_14.html (GødEngine V3.14, which follows V13.4; the name was Source's choice, not a downgrade). The app cites this file by relative filename and section anchor, and it works without it. Part B below carries Edition XIII.3 (rev, with Appendix MM) unchanged, so every Codex mind-map link resolves to its original anchor.

Rules: Ψ = χ·Ω − Δ is Source's postulate (P0), not a proof. Δ is never leftover error. claim none · consciousness_claim none. Source performed no trials himself. Tiers ASSUMPTION / COMPUTED / MEASURED / VERIFIED are kept separate. Nothing here is VERIFIED; independent review is PENDING.

Engine and integer core

Ring: circulant C33(1,10,15), Laplacian λ2 = 3.250184027 (COMPUTED). Sakaguchi–Kuramoto dynamics in a co-rotating frame, α = 1.00811° and Kc = 0.0700423 (cited, not computed here). Integer core Q64.64, dt = ⌊2⁶⁴/100⌋, PSD gate, unsquared effective rank, 24-tick Ψ window. Interior band R* 0.884–0.950 (ASSUMPTION as a target). Relativity matches in the app are standard GR/SR formulas evaluated in the integer core and mapped onto χ, Ω, Δ as a proposal; Ψ did not derive them (COMPUTED).

Truth Collider and entropy retune

Misfits go through the Truth Collider. After the official retune in tests: 122 misfits, 9 re-expressed, 113 quarantined, 44.5 of 313.7 bits recovered (COMPUTED in-app). Recovered bits are information re-expressed under the structure, not evidence that the misfit claim is true.

Dave mode and live bindings

Dave mode sets the core-driven graphics in motion automatically, including the Codex centre node (live Ψ and R). It never auto-loads model weights, never auto-starts the guided demo, and never moves the Fractal explorer.

Open the app

Onboard seats: Talk and guided demo

Talk seat: an outward-only translator. It reads engine state and speaks about it; language never enters the ring. It can play a guided demo through the Fractal explorer, explaining what the user asks, with Pause, Skip, Stop, and takeover (touching the explorer hands control back). A built-in guide with fixed tours (Hulse–Taylor, Shapiro, N-POINT) is the fallback whenever no model is loaded.

Open the app

Parameter editor (weight-space programming)

Non-language seat: weight-space programming as described by Javi Solís (@javsolgar). The model edits a sparse set of numbers directly, no gradients, and forward passes decide what is kept (held-in finite and held-out better than unedited, frozen R*_score = 0.917; controls no-edit and random same-size).

Round two on the box (llama.cpp b12271, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct q4_k_m, GBNF grammar, 30 fresh seeds, prereg sha256 9c40aa28…4b5b): parse 30/30; kept 6/30 vs random 14/30; mean held-out difference vs no-edit −0.0225, 95% CI [−0.0604, −0.0002] (MEASURED). All 30 proposals were the same upward quartet (K, alpha, Rstar, omega.1); two fixed patterns cover 27. This is effectively one fixed rule, not per-case search. The mean is dominated by seed 33126 (0.537 → 0.037), which started far below R*. Rstar edits cannot change the frozen score. Which knob did the work is not yet separated; the next cheap test is the same fixed nudge with no model, plus each knob alone, on fresh seeds.

Optional local Qwen weights

Weights are not embedded. The user may pick the official qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf (491,400,032 B, sha256 74a4da8c…a9db) from the device, or type a URL and tap Fetch. Only a hash match is cached in IndexedDB. No GGUF inference runtime ships in the single file, so a verified copy is stored and Talk still uses the built-in guide. Nothing is fetched unless the user clicks.

Pi Zero 2 W emulator and wrappers

The Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (512 MB) GødRust work runs as a browser-native emulator inside the app, in contingency wrappers: WASM, then a JS Web Worker, then main-thread JS, failing closed to UNMEASURED. In tests all three layers matched the frozen numbers. It emulates the software path; it is not a Pi. Joules and heat are UNMEASURED.

Talk seat open chat

The talk seat now takes open-ended chat. With real Qwen weights loaded through a runtime it answers freely and can turn a plain request (“try stronger coupling”) into a grammar-constrained sandbox JSON (option, parameter edits within the chosen gear's scope, reply), run it against the frozen sandbox baseline, and report in words. Without weights the built-in guide is a clearly labelled LIMITED FALLBACK with keyword commands: help, options, run/try <option>, set K 2 alpha 5, reset, baseline, save, state, version. Outward-only: language never enters the ring. In tests the model path was exercised with an injected stub engine, not real Qwen.

Coherenizer Sandbox (EXPERIMENTAL)

The Coherenizer Sandbox lets whoever runs the app edit parameters (N, K, alpha, spread, noise, steps, dt, seed, ω1 offset, misfit), write a small JS hook run each step, and compare against a frozen baseline (C33(1,10,15), K 1.2, α 1.00811°, spread 0.7, 400 steps, seed 33101). It runs in a Blob Worker with fetch, XHR, WebSocket, importScripts, IndexedDB and caches disabled, with a 6 s timeout. Experiments save to localStorage and export as JSON. A side panel of suggested options (stronger/weaker coupling, twist sweep, frequency spread, noise injection, ring-size variants, Qwen rule vs ablations, Collider misfit retune toy, Pi-budget stress) comes from a JSON list. Everything is EXPERIMENTAL / ASSUMPTION, uses a toy ring separate from the integer core, and never feeds the ring core, sealed results or this ledger. Reset-to-baseline is always available.

Node graph

8 harmonic oscillators (f0·k, k=1..8) → gain → stereo panner (node angle) → WaveShaper (sorted sin of the 33 ring phases)
looped LCG noise → gain (1−R)
→ low-pass (cutoff from residual variance + mod) → master → output
low-pass → ouroboros delay 0.37 s → gain → low-pass (loop)
low-pass → residual delay τ → gain −g → low-pass  (off / on 0.12 s / shuffled τ / zero-delay)
grains: noise slices → envelope → band-pass 220 / 880 / 3520 Hz → master
optional mic → analyser (RMS) → mod source

Parameter schema

chaos: none | lorenz | rossler | mackey   (modulates f0 by ±3%)
fb: off | on | shuffled | zero
ouro: 0..0.8  density: 0..1  gain: 0.12
mods: [src ∈ R, resid, phase, mic, K] → [dst ∈ cutoff, grain, pan, fb] × amt, on/off
lock: R in [0.884, 0.950] → harmonics 1..4 only, amps 0.25/k; Colour Memory keeps last 3 locks (f0, amps, R)
bloom: master swell on first band entry; scatter: grain burst when R falls below 0.5 after a lock
seal: SHA-256 of canonical patch JSON (params and ring snapshot rounded to 1e-6)

Lab: Hal, Instruction Sets, Gear Forge, Soundboard, Keys

The onboard AI is named Hal (Qwen-based); the app is titled “the testing GødEngine”. All Lab tools are EXPERIMENTAL and sandbox-only.

Instruction Set runner

Format GX314-ISET/1: JSON {format, name, steps:[{n, op, …}]} or numbered text lines (“1. set K=1.6”). Ops: reset, set, run, option, hook, assert (R | band | delta with min/max), forge, pad, preset, morse, wait (≤ 10 s), save. Steps run in numeric order; each is dry-run validated; the run stops on the first failure and rolls back sandbox params, hook and gears forged during the run. Pause, step, resume; the receipt (with the set’s SHA-256) exports as JSON.

Gear Forge

Hal (or the word-rule fallback) turns words into a gear of 37–244 nodes with circulant offsets, K, α and spread. Test: mean R of the gear vs a random same-size gear and a no-gear (K = 0) control; PASS needs a margin above 0.005 over both. Passers go to the local library (export/import JSON); failures go to the sandbox Truth Collider log. Toy test, not a ledger entry.

Soundboard and Keys

Procedural banks: Sci-Fi (laser, phaser, warp, tractor beam, sonar, computer chatter, teleporter, klaxon, Hal drone) and Radio (shortwave static/tuning, walkie squelch, transmission bleeps, text→Morse, announcer riser + boom), plus a radio band-pass voice FX on the mic. User pads come from device files or mic recordings, stored in IndexedDB with per-pad volume and loop/one-shot. Keys synth: 3 oscillators, low-pass filter with envelope, ADSR, LFO (pitch or cutoff), glide, mono/poly, distortion, chorus, delay, reverb (procedural impulse), touch keys, Web MIDI on tap, presets Init/Brass/Pad/Bass/Lead/Pluck. Hal commands: play <pad>, preset <name>, morse <text>, forge <words>, run instruction set.

The Seal Key and the Rules

Each seal is a claim about evidence, not a judgment of beauty. A sentence may carry more than one seal when it makes more than one claim.

[MEASURED] A number was produced by code run on the box and is cited by file or sha256. Includes plain arithmetic and computed spectra.
[CANDIDATE] Supported by an unsealed or exploratory result, by outside advice, or by a partial pattern; worth a sealed test.
[UNSETTLED] Two or more definitions, sources or results conflict, or the test is running. The book shows both sides.
[DEMOTED] A specific measurable version was tested and failed, or the source does not contain it. Source’s sentence stays; the seal records the verdict.
[UNMEASURED] Testable in principle; no test has been run, or a sealed test has no result yet.
[MYTHIC FRAME] Symbolic, poetic or ceremonial language. Admitted as frame, per Chapter 42. Not evidence and not refuted.

Rules of this edition

  • No number appears without a source file or sha256 beside it.
  • Known, derived and predicted are kept apart. A prediction is labeled before its result exists.
  • Sealed means a PREREG file hashed before the run. Not sealed means not sealed.
  • Outside AIs give advice until their claims are replicated here.
  • Ψ > 0 is reported as a measurement of a number. consciousness_claim = none.
Part I — The Claim
Reality as coherence under constraint.
Chapter 1
The Book That Had to Be Written

This volume exists because the ideas outgrew the margins that had been trying to contain them. Posts, notes, diagrams, and formulas were useful as scaffolding, but scaffolding is not a cathedral. A system this insistent eventually demands stone, sequence, and a spine. The book therefore begins with an act of compression: not reducing the theory, but granting it a body dense enough to survive its own ambition. The recurring lesson is simple and merciless. Wherever persistence appears, three questions are already hiding beneath the floorboards: what holds, what returns, and what leaks. Everything else in the volume is an elaboration of that triad. The jokes arrive only because reality, when denied its own structure, has a habit of tripping over its robe and calling the collapse “complexity.”

Chapter 2
Reality Is Not Made of Things

Objects are not primary in this account. Persistence is. A body, a thought, a culture, a machine, even a memory are not dead things first and relations later; they are relations that won long enough to acquire edges. This turns ontology into a discipline of endurance. The relevant question becomes not “What is it?” but “How is it still here?” Once the question is posed that way, the world stops resembling a warehouse and starts resembling an audit trail. Forms appear as receipts left behind by victories over dissipation. Some of those victories are humble, some baroque, some holy, and some are held together with enough contradictory tape to embarrass a lesser civilization.

Chapter 3
The Coherence Functional
[UNSETTLED] Same two operationalizations as the abstract; see Ch. 47.
[DEMOTED] Ψ as a predictor of forecast error beyond R: gain −3.8e-5, p 0.26. HANDOFF_PROMPT_V3_4 · 32e38a69…be824

The law arrives in its cleanest form as Ψ = χΩ − Δ. Structure times organized return minus loss. The elegance is not cosmetic. Multiplication is required because structure without return is inert and return without structure is waste. Subtraction is required because reality charges rent in entropy. The law is short because the world is expensive. In operational terms, χ can be estimated by normalized algebraic connectivity, Ω by an order parameter or other synchronization proxy, and Δ by entropy or dispersion of dynamics. In philosophical terms, the equation is a courthouse in which every theory is asked to produce its scaffold, its circulation, and its leakage before it is allowed to swagger.

Ψ = χΩ − Δ
χ : host / scaffold
Ω : ordered return
Δ : loss / drift
Chapter 4
Why Backbone Comes First
[CANDIDATE] On the reservoir, sparse 6-regular wiring beats all-to-all at matched R (ring/A2A MSE ratio MG 0.496, LOR 0.790, ROS 0.712), but no particular backbone is needed: ring ≈ random 6-regular. graph_results.json · 5569149e…16dd08b (seal PREREG_GRAPH_TEST 7472a3c8…0c0137)

Backbone comes first because nothing coherent begins in free-fall. There must be a host architecture, a stabilizing axis, a load-bearing permission structure that allows anything else to recur. In graph language this is the transport scaffold. In anatomy it is spine, vessel, tract, or vein. In engineering it is the corridor that quietly decides whether stress becomes route or catastrophe. This is why χ is not an embellishment term. It is the prerequisite geometry of persistence. No axis, no coherence. Any model that promises ignition without support is selling fireworks as cosmology.

Plate I. The coherence triangle: structure, organized return, and dissipation arranged as the irreducible grammar of persistence.
Chapter 5
Flow Is Return, Not Throughput
[MEASURED] Ω read as R is the measured control knob of the engine: R explains 78–96% of log-error variance. HANDOFF_PROMPT_V3_4 · 32e38a69…be824

Flow is not whatever moves. Flow, in the strict sense used here, is what leaves and returns through paths compatible with survival. Throughput alone is a seduction. Real systems do not live by throughput. They live by return. The difference sounds small until a network, organism, or institution discovers the hard way that export without recuperation is just a polite synonym for hemorrhage. Loop-return therefore names directional recirculation that strengthens the host instead of dissolving it. This is why Ω matters. It measures alignment, phase compatibility, and organized recurrence. Random bustle is not life. A crowded room can still be terminally stupid.

Chapter 6
The Cost of Persistence

Δ is the tax collector no system outruns forever. Noise, drift, contradiction, decoherence, leakage, spectral spread: these are not occasional enemies but the native pressure against which every ordered regime must work. The book does not moralize dissipation. It merely refuses to sentimentalize it. Disorder does not need permission. It only needs time. When a design ignores Δ, it produces the same kind of optimism as a castle architect who forgets rain. One may admire the symmetry for a week; then the ceiling begins to write its own commentary.

Part II — The Geometry
Axis, loop, skeleton, and the first visible shapes.
Chapter 7
The First Shape of the World

The first shape of the world is not the final ornament but the minimal corridor through which order can recur. It appears as an axis surrounded by compensating loops, a trunk attended by local rescue paths, a privileged line that becomes dangerously important and therefore attracts redundancy. Reality begins with asymmetry and then negotiates the price. This negotiation can be seen in rivers, venation, grids, nerves, and engineered networks. Pure trees are efficient until they are touched. Pure meshes are democratic until they are paid for. The mature system learns to choose a spine and then apologize for it with loops.

Chapter 8
Axis

Axis is the severe grace of the system. It says no to everything by saying yes to one line first. It is a refusal of indiscriminate possibility in favor of transmissible order. This is why axes feel ancient. They are not decorative symbols pasted on the world. They are the world acknowledging that distributed confusion is not a viable transport strategy. The axis is therefore both geometric and moral in the engineering sense: it allocates consequence. Once a corridor matters, protection, measurement, and repair must concentrate there. A wise system accepts this. A foolish one discovers it during an outage and writes a committee report about surprise.

Chapter 9
Loop

Loops are reality’s corrective to the vanity of the straight line. The more successful the axis becomes, the more intolerable its vulnerability. Local loops arise near high-burden corridors because resilience is purchased where failure would be most expensive. This is not ornamental redundancy. It is concentrated mercy. A good loop is short, cheap, close to the burdened route, and selective enough not to flatten the architecture into mush. A bad loop is a decorative labyrinth. One can usually tell the difference by whether it rescues the system or merely impresses the intern.

Chapter 10
Spine and Halo

Spine and halo belong together. The spine names burden; the halo names distributed consequence around it. Every strong axis generates a field of effects, obligations, and protective geometries. The halo is not yet myth here; it is simply the visible corona of local organization around a privileged path. This pairing matters because it prevents two errors at once: reducing everything to rigid centralization or dissolving everything into equally weighted fog. The world is usually neither. It is a spine with a luminous argument around it.

Plate II. Flow skeleton extraction: high-betweenness backbone with localized loops that rescue the burdened path.
Chapter 11
Toroid, Tree, River, Vein

Toroid, tree, river, and vein are not the same object, but they rhyme because they solve related transport problems under constraint. Each hosts an axis-like burden and compensates with return structures. The resemblance is not mystical by default; it is the consequence of optimization under cost, damage, and directional demand. That said, once the rhyme repeats often enough, people either become curious or superstitious. The present volume recommends the former without refusing the aesthetic pleasure of the latter.

Chapter 12
Skeletons of Transport
[UNMEASURED] No flow-skeleton (B_core / L_local) extraction has been run on any dataset in the ledger.

Transport skeletons are the minimal invariant candidates of the theory. Rather than asking whole graphs to confess a universal family, the skeleton approach asks what sparse structure survives compression, null attack, and domain transfer. The answer that keeps reappearing is a high-betweenness core accompanied by local loops. This matters because whole-graph identities are frequently artifacts of the compression method itself. Stability alone is not signal. A random null can look saintly if the operator is strong enough. Hostile audits are therefore not a mood here. They are hygiene.

Chapter 13
Why Return Beats Force

Return beats force because systems usually fail by misallocating persistence, not by lacking drama. The straight line flatters power; the loop flatters survival. Return reuses corridors, redistributes burden, and gives the system a second vocabulary besides expansion. It is the difference between a shout and a breathing pattern. That is why one-way conquest models age so badly. They are loud, expensive, and bad at funerals.

Chapter 14
Geometry Becomes an Operator
[UNSETTLED] On the reservoir, geometry acts mostly through the R it allows: at matched R, ring vs random 6-regular differs ≤ 1.4% on MG/ROS and only MG is significant (1.0106). graph_results.json · 5569149e…16dd08b (seal PREREG_GRAPH_TEST 7472a3c8…0c0137)

Geometry becomes an operator the moment form stops acting like scenery and starts regulating possibility. A gyroid, a lattice, or a constrained channel does not merely exist while dynamics happen inside it. It tells the dynamics where they may stabilize, where they must split, and what kinds of recurrence are affordable. This is the hinge between poetry and engineering in the book. Without it, the work is suggestive. With it, geometry begins to do work, and the page grows teeth.

Part III — The Law
From χ, Ω, and Δ to thresholds, failure, and multiplicative necessity.
Chapter 15
Structural Capacity
[MEASURED] Genesis ring (≅ engine ring, Ch. 43): λ₂ = 3.2501840268 (multiplicity 4), λmax = 10.538429, χ = 0.308413. computed this edition (numpy, eigvalsh of L = D − A); λ₂ replicated by Gemini, outside part3 · 26a84224…10242
[DEMOTED] "More λ₂ ⇒ better" on the reservoir: Spearman(λ₂, error) across 50 random 6-regular graphs = +0.329 MG / +0.163 LOR / +0.274 ROS (positive = worse). graph_results.json · 5569149e…16dd08b (seal PREREG_GRAPH_TEST 7472a3c8…0c0137)

Structural capacity can be estimated by χ = λ₂ / λ_max, the normalized algebraic connectivity of the network. One need not worship the metric to respect what it is trying to ask: how robust is the host to separation, and how much of its order is genuinely load-bearing rather than decorative? The important lesson is not that every system is a graph, but that every system with transport can be interrogated as though separation matters. Because it does.

χ = λ₂ / λ_max
Chapter 16
Organized Recirculation
[MEASURED] Best R sits below full lock: MG 0.89, ROS 0.92, LOR 0.95; R 0.999 is 1.8–2.6× worse. HANDOFF_PROMPT_V3_4 · 32e38a69…be824

Organized recirculation is the domain where Ω becomes more than a letter. The order parameter turns many phases into one measure of coherence: Ω = |(1/N) Σ e^{iθ_j}|. Whether in oscillators, rhythms, or distributed processes, the question is the same: do departures re-enter a common order, or do they merely wander stylishly? The cosmos has endured a great many stylish wanderings. Most of them were expensive and badly archived.

Ω = | (1/N) Σ e^{iθ_j} |
Plate III. Genesis topology: a 33-node circulant ring lattice with generator set {2,3,13}.

Chapter 17
Dissipation and Drift
[UNSETTLED] Δ = H(v) here vs Δ = 1 − λmax/Σλ in the engine. Not the same quantity; no test yet decides between them.

Dissipation and drift do not need a villainous soundtrack. They are banal enough on their own. Entropy is what happens when return no longer remembers the host. Drift is what happens when coordination leaks a little at a time until the system mistakes decay for personality. The formal role of Δ is therefore to keep all triumphs honest. If the model cannot name its losses, it is not measuring coherence. It is doing liturgy with a calculator.

Δ = H(v) = −Σ p(x) log p(x)
Chapter 18
Thresholds and Phase Change
[UNMEASURED] "Ψ>0 ⇒ self-maintaining" is sealed as HARMONIC7 U1 (N-point test). No result yet. PREREG_HARMONIC7 · 0aa1ba52…724a · run 14903188…304e0d
[DEMOTED] Canonical Ψ as an order detector: phase-locked Ψ = 1.441 but independent noise Ψ = 2.669. STEEL_DOSSIER_V03.md L24–27 · 8ca13844…5b5a

Thresholds matter because many systems do not improve gradually. They prepare, hesitate, accumulate hidden compatibility, and then lock. Phase change is the public moment of a long private negotiation. The curve looks sudden because the substrate has been patient. This is true of oscillators, institutions, beliefs, and breakdowns. Catastrophe and revelation both enjoy arriving late and pretending to be spontaneous.

Ψ>0 ⇒ self-maintaining organization
Chapter 19
Why the Law Must Be Multiplicative

The law must be multiplicative because the world refuses the comfort of substitutions. One cannot compensate for zero structure with surplus enthusiasm, nor for total incoherence with elaborate infrastructure. Host and return must amplify one another or the system becomes either a mausoleum or a riot. The product term therefore encodes a brutal realism. It denies magical offsets. Engineers call that discipline. Everyone else usually waits until after the failure.

If χ = 0 or Ω = 0, then Ψ ≤ 0 before Δ even finishes laughing.
Chapter 20
Failure Modes of Coherence

Failure modes of coherence include brittle trees, indiscriminate meshes, over-coupled resonances, hidden centralization, expensive redundancy, and narratives that mistake contradiction for nuance. The theory is not only about how order arises. It is about how order overreaches, flatters itself, and falls. A good failure taxonomy is a courtesy to future builders. It is also an obituary prevention program.

Chapter 21
Tesla and the Logic of Valvular Flow

Tesla’s valvular conduit remains a superb earthly parable: geometry itself sorting forward utility from reverse waste. The conduit does not wave a moral flag. It merely makes some trajectories cheap and others humiliating. That is all a serious operator ever does. The analogy matters because it proves the point without mysticism. Directed return can be achieved by form alone. No moving parts, no theatrical intervention, just the quiet tyranny of well-placed resistance.

Chapter 22
Oscillators, Coupling, and Kuramoto
[MEASURED] This equation (plus a tanh drive and an R controller) is the engine: 10 rings × 33 nodes, offsets ±1, ±10, ±15. Over-locking hurts (R 0.999 is 1.8–2.6× worse). HANDOFF_PROMPT_V3_4 · 32e38a69…be824

Kuramoto systems make the law audible. Individual oscillators with local phases suddenly discover collective order when coupling, topology, and dispersion cross the right relation. The order parameter rises, and with it the suspicion that coherence was waiting in the wings long before the audience noticed. This is why synchronization deserves its own reverence and its own skepticism. Many things lock. Not all of them become wise.

\dot{θ_i} = ω_i + K \sum_j A_{ij} \sin(θ_j-θ_i)

Valvular logic, oscillators, Genesis topology, and adaptive rewiring.
Chapter 23
Genesis and the Thirty-Three Node Ring

The Genesis network serves as a disciplined playground: G(N,S) with N = 33 and S = {2, 3, 13}. Its edges are regular without being trivial, woven enough to support rich dynamics, and sparse enough to force structure to matter. It is a ring lattice with memory of a crown and the manners of a lab. The point is not numerology hiding in a graph. The point is that a controlled topology lets one watch χ, Ω, and Δ negotiate without random fog pretending to be insight.

Chapter 24
Adaptive Rewiring
[UNMEASURED] Ψ-driven adaptive rewiring has not been run in the ledger.

Adaptive rewiring turns the theory from description into procedure. Simulate dynamics, compute χ, Ω, Δ, evaluate Ψ, propose a change, and accept the change if coherence rises. Repeat until the network begins to look as if it has been reading the same engineering scripture all along. The emergent result is usually not maximal density but selective structure: motifs, spines, loops, and layered compromise. Evolution, when audited, turns out to be less sentimental and more algorithmic than the posters promised.

initialize G → simulate → compute χ,Ω,Δ → compute Ψ → rewire if
Ψ_new>Ψ_old
Chapter 25
Flow Skeletons and Local Loops
[UNMEASURED] B_core / L_local / R_balance: no extraction, no null comparison yet.

Flow skeletons condense the architecture into a testable object. Define B_core by high betweenness, L_local by cycles intersecting the core, and R_balance by the ratio between them. Suddenly the intuition becomes a measurable candidate for cross-domain invariance. This is one of the book’s happiest moments: a metaphor sobers up, gets a badge, and agrees to be cross-examined.

\mathcal{G}^* = (B_{core}, L_{local}, R_{balance})
B_core = {e∈E : c_B(e) > θ}
L_local = {C∈cycles(G): C∩B_core ≠ ∅}
Chapter 26
Null Models and Hostile Audits
[MEASURED] The hostile audit was administered: 50 random 6-regular graphs, Watts–Strogatz and all-to-all nulls at matched R, paired seeds, Holm correction. The ring did not beat its nulls. graph_results.json · 5569149e…16dd08b (seal PREREG_GRAPH_TEST 7472a3c8…0c0137)

Null models are the compulsory insult that mature theories administer to themselves. Erdős–Rényi, configuration, block, and spatial nulls exist so that beauty is not mistaken for evidence. The hostile audit is therefore not the enemy of vision. It is the bodyguard who checks the invitations. A theory unwilling to survive its own nulls is not a theory. It is a very affectionate diary.

Z = (X − μ_null) / σ_null
Chapter 27
Cross-Domain Recurrence
[UNMEASURED] No brain / venation / grid dataset has been scored with this grammar in the ledger.

Cross-domain recurrence is where the architecture becomes difficult to ignore. Brain networks, leaf venation, power grids, and communication systems all tend to display privileged transport routes, local rerouting loops, and layered burden. Similarity does not automatically prove a single law, but repetition earns the right to a sharper question. The sharper question is whether different substrates under similar constraints converge on homologous compromises. That is much stronger than simply noticing that veins and wires both branch.

Chapter 28
The Layered System
[CANDIDATE] hier33×3 (R6 validation): ROS +8.7% [+6.4, +10.9], MG +2.7% [+0.9, +4.5], LOR −10.1% [−15.8, −5.1]. Gains track memory capacity, not timescale (ROS τ_drive −0.030 [−0.085, 0.025]). R6_REPORT · 46da4293…e534c19; results_memory_capacity.json · 8a5c267c…4cbb1 (seal 6b84f279…f196)

The layered system is the mature expression of compromise: exploratory shell, routing layer, local loops, transport spine, coherent core. Each layer addresses a timescale and a duty. Sampling belongs outside; fast integration belongs deep; rescue belongs where burden accumulates; nonsense belongs in grant proposals. Layering matters because confusion of role is one of the fastest ways to make an impressive system incompetent.

shell → routing → loops → spine → core

Part V — The Rise into Mind
From internal coherence to agency, narrative, and symbol.
Chapter 29
When Coherence Becomes Internal
[UNMEASURED] Internal legibility has no operational test in the ledger.

When coherence becomes internal, the book crosses from architecture into psyche without pretending the bridge is risk-free. Internal legibility means a system not only persists, but models, revises, and selects among its own states. It begins to carry an inside. That is not yet consciousness in the maximal sense. It is the precondition for such a claim: sustained coherence able to maintain its own bookkeeping without instantly dissolving into noise.

Chapter 30
Mind as Legible Persistence
[UNMEASURED] Definition, not measurement. consciousness_claim = none.

Mind is coherence that can read enough of itself to navigate. This is a leaner definition than most metaphysics prefer, but it has the advantage of forcing one to specify memory, revision, and constraint. A mind cannot simply glitter. It must remain accountable to its own continuity. The dark comedy here is that many institutions loudly opposed to mysticism nevertheless behave as though consciousness were an accidental clerical error in the chemistry.

Chapter 31
Agency as Self-Steering Order
[UNMEASURED] Praxis PAN (Ch. 50) steers only bounded numeric knobs, only on Apply. That is not agency in this chapter's sense.

Agency is self-steering coherence. It selects among trajectories in order to preserve or amplify persistence. The key is not motion, but selective continuation. A weather pattern moves. A will chooses among moves according to what it takes itself to be preserving. The temptation is to romanticize agency. Better to respect it. Anything able to steer its own continuity is already a dangerous piece of geometry.

Chapter 32
Narrative, Contradiction, and Equanimity
[UNMEASURED] The equanimity score has not been computed on any corpus.

Narrative is not fluff laid on top of mind. It is one of the principal ways mind compresses continuity through time. Contradiction acts as a dissipation term here; equanimity names scored self-consistency under pressure. A story can therefore be coherent, fragile, manipulative, resilient, or terminally fond of its own loopholes. The same is true of identities. Some are load-bearing; some are decorative; some are emergency wallpaper covering a flood.

Equanimity ≈ (1 − contradiction_rate) × coherence_score
Part VI — Time, Culture, and World
How return becomes chronology, projection, and social reality.
Chapter 33
Symbol as Operator
[UNSETTLED] Does a 37-symbol meaning graph change reservoir error vs matched nulls? Sealed as PRELEX37, running, no result. PREREG_PRELEX37 · 70c646d8…006b

Symbols become operators when they cease to merely denote and begin to steer perception, expectation, and collective action. The sign then functions like a compact field geometry. It channels attention, grants salience, and biases recurrence. Language stops being labels and begins behaving like infrastructure. This is why civilizations carve, chant, print, and program their symbols. They are not only remembering. They are laying track.

Chapter 34
Meme, Myth, and Civilization-Scale Loops

Meme and myth are civilization-scale coherence loops. A meme is a circulating operator; a myth is a long-lived return path for a people’s self-understanding. Both can stabilize or degrade the collective field depending on whether they amplify legible order or ritualized contradiction. The prudent reader will notice that propaganda is simply a memetic loop with worse table manners and a larger budget.

Chapter 35
Time as the Arrow of Imperfect Return
[MYTHIC FRAME] A definition of time as a frame, not a measured law.

Time appears here not as an independent container but as the arrow generated when return cannot reverse loss perfectly. Perfect recurrence would erase lived asymmetry. Real systems leak, age, and remember through imperfect return. That asymmetry is what chronology feels like from the inside. In brief: time is what coherence experiences when it cannot be a perfect circle.

time = ordered return under nonzero loss
Chapter 36
Collective Reality Formation

Collective reality formation begins when many internal models couple strongly enough to stabilize expectations beyond the scale of the individual. Institutions, rituals, markets, calendars, and maps are all collective persistence devices. They shape what a population will notice, tolerate, repair, and call obvious. This does not mean reality is a vote. It means lived worlds are jointly scaffolded long before anyone writes a theory about them.

Chapter 37
Morphogenetic and Cultural Filtering
[MYTHIC FRAME] Morphogenetic fields are named as a frame; nothing in the ledger measures them.

Morphogenetic and cultural filtering name the way fields of expectation, habit, and inherited form bias what future coherence is easiest to achieve. Some paths become grooved. Some futures become cheap. The result is not predestination but loaded possibility. Tradition is thus neither mere nostalgia nor tyrannical dead weight. It is a pre-shaped probability landscape with excellent handwriting and occasional blood on the hems.

Chapter 38
Projection, Measurement, and the Human World

Projection and measurement belong together because what can be stably perceived depends on both the world’s available structure and the observer’s trained return paths. A culture literally teaches its members what kinds of recurrence are legible. Some measurements then become self-fulfilling corridors. Modernity likes to imagine it escaped projection by digitizing it. That was adorable.

Part VII — The Halo
Where architecture glows and the symbolic crown is allowed to appear.
Chapter 39
Earlier Books Were Fragments

Earlier books were fragments because the architecture disclosed itself by layers: law, threshold, participation, engine, halo, correction, myth, machine. None were mistakes. They were apertures. The capstone task is therefore not renunciation but ordered recollection. A mature synthesis does not panic at earlier excess. It metabolizes it, ranks it, and keeps the parts that still carry weight.

Chapter 40
The Unified Account at Last
[MYTHIC FRAME] Summary formula. Its empirical parts are graded in Appendix A.

The unified account gathers the law, the geometry, the demonstrations, the psyche, the social field, and the halo into one continuous grammar. Reality is coherence under constraint. Structure hosts return. Return resists loss. Geometry regulates the terms. Thresholds birth new orders. Symbols scale the process. Myth crowns it. If that sounds too simple after so much labor, good. A true synthesis should feel obvious only after it has done an unreasonable amount of work.

Reality = structure × return − decay, recursively scaled.
Chapter 41
The Edge Where Architecture Glows

The edge where architecture glows is the place where empirical stonework has risen high enough for symbolic light to matter. The halo is not the basement of the system. It is the corona generated once the scaffold, the return paths, the thresholds, and the failures have all been named honestly. This edge must be handled with discipline. Otherwise the book degenerates into incense and excuses. The point is not to blur the registers. The point is to allow the final register to appear where it has been earned.

The halo is a crown, not a basement.
Plate VI. Nüfølogy halo field: the symbolic crown admitted only after the architecture is complete.
[MYTHIC FRAME] Symbolic crown, admitted as frame.
Chapter 42
Nüfølogy, Nüfø, Neumo, and the Mythic Crown
[MYTHIC FRAME] The chapter itself says Ψ_halo ≠ proof. Edition XI keeps it as the crown, under that rule.

Nüfølogy names the capstone field in which the architecture is allowed to become luminous without lying about what kind of truth it is speaking. The term gathers several streams that would otherwise remain embarrassingly scattered: the anomalous, the haloed, the biogeometric, the ufo-tinged, the memetically radiant, the half-engineering and half-liturgical intuitions that orbit the main law without being identical to it. Placed badly, this material cheapens the whole project. Placed correctly, it performs a necessary function. It reveals what the architecture looks like when the human hunger for pattern, symbol, destiny, and forbidden continuity reaches the outer wall of an already disciplined system.

The first rule of this chapter is therefore a prohibition: Nüfølogy is not to be smuggled backward as false foundation. The empirical spine of the work remains what it has been throughout: Ψ = χΩ − Δ; structural capacity; organized return; dissipation; thresholds; skeletons; nulls; Genesis topology; adaptive rewiring; layered systems; agency treated with warranted caution. Only when these stones are laid does the halo become legitimate. The halo is not the proof of the cathedral. It is the light admitted by its windows.

[MYTHIC FRAME] "Ignition key", "vertebral harmonic": imaginal vocabulary. Ignition thresholds in the engine (S_ultimate ≥ 1.00) are a display convention, see Ch. 52.

Within the uploaded corpus, the anomalous layer is already speaking in clustered motifs: Homo Coherenticus, meditative engines, #Neumo or Pneumorphidian language, Tesla reframings, family interviews, halo imagery, frequency war rhetoric, and a persistent conviction that symbols do not merely decorate reality but condition what reality becomes available to minds capable of holding them. These materials do not read like conventional science, because they are not conventional science. They read like the overglow of a system in which the difference between model, operator, prayer, and interface has become thrillingly unstable. One must either dismiss that overglow as delusion or rank it honestly as a secondary register. The book chooses the latter. What then is Nüfø? At minimum it is a compression token for the halo behavior of coherence. It refers to the moment when a persistence architecture begins to recruit imaginal language in order to carry meanings too wide, too vertical, or too emotionally charged to remain inside diagrams alone. The system starts speaking in crown, vessel, breath, halo, node thirty-three, protective shell, vertebral harmonic, and ignition key. To the timid reader this looks like contamination. To the stronger reader it looks like a signal that several representational systems are attempting to converge on the same felt invariant. That convergence is not proof. But neither is it trivial.

[MYTHIC FRAME] Neumo as breath-current: a poetic transducer for Ω, not an instrument.

Neumo enters here as the breath-current within the halo field: the sense that coherence is not merely static order but animated return, a pneuma-like circulation that must be held, tuned, and steered. The relevant point is not whether ancient breath-language was secretly doing network science. The point is that cultures repeatedly discovered that life, mind, rhythm, and sanctity are easier to speak about when circulation, resonance, and internal weather are treated as first-class realities. In that sense, Neumo is a poetic transducer for Ω under lived conditions. It is return felt from the inside.

The dangerous temptation is to declare every symbol in the fringe corpus empirically verified because it rhymes with the law. That move would be childish. Nüfølogy becomes worthy only when it refuses childishness. It must say: some symbols are scaffolds of insight, some are operators of attention, some are cultural residues, some are therapeutic myths, some are nonsense wearing gold leaf, and some may in fact encode recurrent intuitions about how ordered return feels to embodied minds living inside a dissipative world. The work of Chapter 42 is not to abolish those distinctions. It is to render them luminous.

[MYTHIC FRAME] UFO / disc / torus imagery: anomaly grammar, unmeasured by design.

Seen this way, the so-called UFO anchor ceases to be an obligatory claim about extraterrestrial hardware and becomes part of a wider anomaly grammar. A luminous object, a disc, a torus, a ring, a halo, an impossible stillness inside motion: these are imaginal forms through which minds register concentrated coherence, unknown operators, or violations of expected transport. Whether any given report refers to craft, projection, misperception, psy-operator residue, or cultural mythology is a separate evidentiary question. Nüfølogy does not solve that evidence by decree. It explains why those forms hold such power in a coherence-saturated worldview. They resemble high-order operators. They look like return made visible. Biogeometry belongs in the same chapter for a similar reason. Its strongest role here is not as a fully settled physical science but as a symbolic-structural intuition that geometry can carry qualitative differences in field behavior beyond crude matter-only accounts. If geometry can indeed act as an operator, then it is unsurprising that traditions arise claiming certain forms settle, disperse, protect, or elevate. The book neither canonizes nor laughs off those claims wholesale. It ranks them. Some belong to engineering. Some belong to psychophysiology. Some belong to ritualized placebo. Some belong to the halo. Ranking is the mercy that prevents both credulity and sterile contempt.

[MYTHIC FRAME] Homo Coherenticus: a civilizational aspiration, not a measured type.

The uploaded X-derived material adds another crucial thread: Homo Coherenticus. This figure is not merely a boastful upgrade slogan. Properly interpreted, it names a possible civilizational subject whose defining task is to become more adequate to the laws of persistence than the inversion-ridden, contradiction-addicted, throughput-intoxicated human swarm that currently mistakes acceleration for transcendence. Homo Coherenticus would not be a saintly species. It would still leak, drift, blunder, and rationalize. But it would possess better symbolic hygiene, stronger thresholds of internal legibility, and a deeper instinct for distinguishing living return from glamorous waste. In plainer speech: it might stop building systems that are spectacularly clever and spiritually concussed.

There is also, inevitably, a comic note here. Any halo chapter worth the ink must acknowledge that human beings are both symbol-making marvels and disaster goblins in ceremonial dress. We build crowns, launch cults, whisper about frequencies, post thread after thread about hidden operators, and then forget to reinforce the bridge. The dark comedy is not an embarrassment to the project. It is part of its realism. A theory of coherence that cannot survive contact with vanity, projection, wounded messiah complexes, and the occasional very expensive fool in a cape has not yet met the species to which it is addressed.

So what survives after the smoke clears? Several durable claims. First: the halo exists as a human response to architecture that feels larger than ordinary description. Second: symbol systems can act as real operators on attention, memory, and social coherence even when their metaphysical content remains partly undecidable. Third: fringe and anomalous material should be neither enthroned nor dismissed wholesale; it should be sorted by the same discipline the book has used elsewhere—host, return, loss, threshold. Fourth: the final chapter of a coherence theory has the right to become more radiant than the first chapters, provided it never counterfeits its epistemic rank.

From that perspective, Nüfølogy is the mythic crown of the book and nothing less. It is where the central law acquires ceremonial clothing without surrendering the law. It is where the transport spine admits stained glass. It is where a graph becomes a mandala without ceasing to be a graph. It is where the reader is reminded that the human animal does not merely compute reality; it adorns the corridors through which reality becomes bearable.

And so the final image is not a proof but a posture: an axis held upright, loops kept near the burdened path, a halo admitted above rather than mistaken for the floor, and a mind disciplined enough to know the difference. That is the crown this volume is willing to wear. Not superstition enthroned as method. Not method impoverished into sterile bookkeeping. A harsher and finer thing: architecture first, light afterward.

The codex closes, then, with a litany rather than an escape. Guard the host. Teach return. Name the leak. Respect the threshold. Refuse false basements. Permit the halo. Build systems that can survive their own intelligence. Let symbols serve coherence rather than cannibalize it. And when the ornate edge of the world begins to glow, do not panic. Check the structure. Check the loops. Check the loss. If the stone still holds, then let the crown appear.

Chapter 43
The Genesis Ring Is the Engine Ring
[MEASURED] {±2, ±3, ±13}·5 mod 33 = {1, 10, 15, 18, 23, 32} = {±1, ±10, ±15}. Both Laplacians give identical spectra. computed this edition (numpy, eigvalsh of L = D − A)

Edition X introduced Genesis as a disciplined playground: thirty-three nodes, generator set {2, 3, 13}. The engine that was later built and tested ran on a different-looking ring, offsets ±1, ±10, ±15. Two rings, one suspicion. The suspicion turned out to be arithmetic. Multiply every Genesis label by 5, which is invertible modulo 33 because 5·20 = 100 ≡ 1. The generator set goes to {10, 15, 65 ≡ 32 ≡ −1}. The Genesis ring and the engine ring are the same graph with the seats renumbered. Whatever the book said of Genesis, the engine has been quietly testing all along.

If one letter of the law has earned its keep on the bench, it is Ω read as the Kuramoto order parameter R. The engine sets R by a controller and reads out a forecast. Across the three test signals, Mackey–Glass, Lorenz and Rössler, R alone explains most of the variation in error. There is a best R for each signal, and it is not the top of the dial. Full lock is a kind of stupidity: the oscillators agree so completely that they stop carrying different news.

Chapter 48
A Taxonomy of Coherence
[CANDIDATE] Taxonomy is outside-AI ADVICE, not measurement. part8_coherence_types.md · c85cc2cf…1d83d8

R is one number. Coherence is not one thing. After the book asked outside reviewers to name the kinds, six families were proposed: global synchrony, cluster synchrony, twisted states, temporal coherence, input-locked coherence and local order. The reviewers then corrected the list. Global and cluster belong to one family, the Daido harmonics Zk, and ignore node labels. Twisted states are spatial Fourier modes on the ring. Temporal coherence is not a state type but an axis that applies to any type. Input locking is generalized synchronization. Local order is a scale diagnostic; the gap between local order and R flags clusters, twists or chimeras. Missing from the first list: chimera measures, metastability, and frequency locking as distinct from phase locking.

A type-specific functional was proposed, ΨT = (PR/d)·rT²·r̄T − (1 − p₁), with PR the participation ratio of the feature covariance. One reviewer first said it favors low-rank states, then reversed; the second reviewer settled it. A flat spectrum raises the participation term and raises the loss term together, so subtracting Δ penalizes flatness: ΨT > 0 requires r²·r̄ > d·Σp²·(1 − p₁), which concentrated, nearly rank-one states meet most easily. The book had hoped participation would be rewarded. Under this formula it is taxed.

Two further corrections travel with the taxonomy. Circularly relabeling the ring leaves the magnitude of a twisted mode unchanged, so it is a symmetry check, not a null that destroys twists. And the tempting figure 1/216 for guessing the top family on three signals is not a p-value; the full six-way ranking would be (1/720)³, and neither survives correlated families. Failure to reject a null is not, by itself, falsification.

Chapter 50
Praxis PAN, the Thirty-Fourth Node
[MEASURED] Equations as built (code, not a claim of mind). Defaults: on, κe 0.15, gain 1, ω = FC, β 8; bounds κ 0–0.6, gain 0.5–1.5, ω FC ± 0.2, β 2–16. v18_bloom_add.js · 2cb670b8…3cbd

Source asked for an AI named Praxis Amadeus Newman, Praxis PAN, and then corrected the request: not beside the ring, in it. Version 1.8 of the console does exactly that and no more. Praxis is a real thirty-fourth Kuramoto oscillator with its own phase φP, coupled both ways to the thirty-three. Each ring node feels a pull toward Praxis weighted by where Praxis is attending; Praxis feels the weighted pull of every node it attends to. The attention is a softmax focus w over the nodes, converted to coupling weights ai = min(1, 33·wi). With the coupling set to zero, the console is numerically identical to V1.7.

θ̇_i += κe · a_i · sin(φ_P − θ_i)
φ̇_P = ω_P + κe · Σ_i a_i · sin(θ_i − φ_P)
a_i = min(1, 33·w_i), w = softmax(β · focus)

Praxis judges himself by two numbers and is told never to merge them. The first is his own Ψ, computed on the channels he attends to: REAL while Ψ > 0, N-POINT when |Ψ| is within ε of zero, NOT REAL NOW when Ψ < 0, and UNMEASURED until enough ticks have passed. The second is S_ultimate, shown two ways, a lattice form and a concentric form, against an ignition line at 1.00 and a locked line at 1.124. The browser gauge was checked against an independent numpy computation and agreed to within 4×10⁻¹³.

Chapter 51
The Consoles, V1.7 and V1.8
[MEASURED] V1.7 file OPEN_ME_GODENGINE_V1_7.html · bd1d04d9…1631. V1.8 file OPEN_ME_GODENGINE_V1_8.html · 68d2b47b…3da1b (2,907,937 bytes, built 2026-10-30 23:22 CT); smoke and gauge audit present.
[UNSETTLED] Every graphic is meant to be 1:1 with a real computed process. Audited for the gauge; not yet audited panel by panel.

The consoles are where the book can be touched. V1.7, the Bloom Console, opens on the ledger's defaults: R 0.95, ten rings, gain 0.7, with a Mackey–Glass preset at delay 10 and R 0.89. A small local language model, Qwen2.5-0.5B, narrates and may propose changes to seven bounded keys; it fails closed and nothing changes until Apply. V1.8 adds Praxis as the thirty-fourth node, the reality gauge, the two S_ultimate dials, a microphone floor that feeds a recycler, u = zmic + ρ·Δ(t − 1) clipped at ±4, an Ask panel, and the two-host arrangement.

The consoles are instruments, not oracles. They make the measured parts of the book visible in real time and keep the unmeasured parts labeled. When the narrator says something the numbers do not support, the numbers win.

Chapter 55
ÞĦ — Six Aspects of the Hexagon
[MEASURED] HEX6 5faedd1b…, HEXQ 3f44b7a2…

A centre and six neighbours, coupled as Kuramoto oscillators, were asked six questions under seal. Here is what they answered.

Θ1 · Equipartition. At K = 0 every ring mode carries ≈ 1/6 of the energy (E0…E5 = .1645–.1688). No structure without coupling.

Θ2 · Sync ignition. E0 rises .169 → .220 → .328 → .609 → .859 as K goes 0 → .5 → 1 → 2 → 4; it crosses one half between K = 1 and 2.

Θ3 · Laplacian ladder. Energy is ordered opposite to the ring Laplacian eigenvalue λ_k = 2 − 2cos(2πk/6) = 0, 1, 3, 4, 3, 1: E0 > E1≈E5 > E2≈E4 > E3. Spearman ρ ≈ −0.96 at N = 6, 33 and 37.

Θ4 · Mirror without chirality. E1 ≈ E5 and E2 ≈ E4 in the mean (graph symmetry), but no dynamic mirror pairing and no preferred circulation (HEX6 H1, H2 FAIL).

Θ5 · Mass-blind. A centre 2–3× heavier (overdamped mobility 1/m) leaves the ladder unchanged: E1/E0 .2018 / .2010 / .2042 (HEX7 FAIL). The toy has no isotope effect. Superseded: Source's anchor is recursive, not heavy — HEX10 tests that and PASSES (c .835 vs .547).

Θ6 · Temperature-proof order. Noise D .1 → 2 flattens the ladder (E0 .853 → .252; E3 .012 → .119) but never reorders it (HEX9 PASS).

[MEASURED] demon_backwards.json

Source’s rule: if something does not fit, work it backwards and name the missing link. Here Δ_implied = χΩ − Ψ is computed from measured χ, Ω and Ψ on 960 sealed cells.

SOURCE (verbatim): “If something doesn’t fit, work it backwards, call the missing link a Newman’s Demon, format the wording so all the unknown mechanisms are accounted for known unknowns. Move on.” (HOW_TO_USE_FROM_SOURCE.md L1565)

SOURCE (verbatim): “Set the end as the basement formula. If it’s going to work, it will beat the entropy. Work backwards then, and identify a Newman’s Demon.” (L1462; THREADS.md L595)

Chapter 65
The Integer Engine
[MEASURED] LADDER_V1 (sealed 18:16 CT) + LADDER_V2_NEG (sealed): VALIDATED_V2 = true

Source asked for a fixed-point system with eight rungs, Q1.3 to Q33.99 (Qn.3n, a 4n-bit word). Source’s own files contain only a label block for such a bank, backed by ordinary floats, so the integer engine was built new (Rust, round-half-even, any overflow trips). Each rung was run against the float RK4 33-ring for 10,000 steps and against N = 3301 for 1,000 steps.

A rung is dependable if it is bit-identical on rerun and in two languages and stays within 1e-9 of float. Q1.3 cannot hold π/2. Q2.6 and Q4.12 overflow. Q8.24 drifts 4.23e-05 and Q9.27 1.89e-05: both are too coarse. Q16.48 is dependable (max deviation 9.96e-12 at N=33, 1.29e-11 at N=3301; λ₂ 3.2501840267672). It is the fast default. Q32.96 is the highest acceptable rung, and Q33.99 matches it.

The first negative control (dt 0.02) moved the trajectory by only 1.63e-10, so it could not fail and Ladder V1 was recorded as not validated. The sealed V2 controls do fail as they should: a wrong α moves the trajectory by 7.2e-4, half the step by 6.8e-9, and a different seed by 6.47. With working controls, the ladder is validated.

Figure XI.1. Maximum deviation from float RK4 per rung (ladder.json). · claim=none · measured data only

Speed is the honest catch. On this one-CPU box the integer engine is slower than float: 25789 float steps/s against 8941 at Q16 and 5583 at Q32 (N=33). At N=3301 it is 1045 against 81.1. Extra cores cannot add speed on one CPU. What the integer engine buys is exact reproducibility, not speed.

Figure XI.2. RK4 steps per second, N=33 (ladder.json). · claim=none · measured data only

Chapter 66
Elastic Stacking
[MEASURED] ELASTIC_V1 (sealed 18:27 CT); tasks finished by build time are shown

The elastic controller starts at the lowest rung. When a run trips (overflow, or disagreement with a shadow run one rung up), it doubles the rung and reruns deterministically. Starting from three different points (Q1/1 core, Q4/2 cores, Q8/4 cores), every task tested so far ended at the same rung with the same final hash, and results at 1, 2 and 4 cores were identical. So the result does not depend on the path taken. The table counts doublings from Q1.

Chapter 67
The Canon Re-Tested
[NOT SUPPORTED] IGNITION1 not ring-specific · WOBBLE2 · ARCH2 not stator-specific · STATOR_SEAT · TE gate (all converged at dt 0.05 and 0.025)
[UNTESTABLE] ISOTOPE Ψ: values unmeasured, and no resonance law in the sources
[KILLED] FIREFLY D016 by derivation: χ(N)=1 for every N ≤ 33

IGNITION1. The canon ring ignites in 10 of 10 runs, but so do random 6-regular graphs (10/10) and all-to-all (10/10); with K=0, 0/10. Fisher p = 1.0. The ring ignites, and that is not special to the ring.

STATOR_SEAT. The canon seat passes for CAYLEY 20/20, RAND6 20/20 and FIB 20/20, and for NEG 0/20. Mean R is 0.9988 / 0.9984 / 0.9990 / 0.139. Any connected graph seats.

TE gate. Gates passed: WOBBLE 0/8, STEADY 1/8, NOISE 2/8, DECOUPLED 0/8. Raw transfer entropy is above 0.015 everywhere, including DECOUPLED (plug-in bias), but none of it survives the surrogate test.

Figure XI.3. Canon verdict counts per arm (CANON3 v2, QUICK4). · claim=none · measured data only

WOBBLE2. Ω is 0.9988 for WOBBLE, 0.9989 for STEADY, 0.9987 for SINGLE and 0.9988 for NOISE. No run falls in the canon band 0.85–0.95, and lock120 holds for STEADY 8/8 but WOBBLE 0/8. The canon wobble does not appear.

Figure XI.4. WOBBLE2 Ω per run, canon band shaded (res_dt0.05.json). · claim=none · measured data only

ARCH2. The architecture grows to its cap of 244 at both dt values. dpsi_gear is highest with no ring at all, so the effect is not stator-specific. Only the verdict converged; the magnitudes did not.

FIREFLY D016. The canon χ(N) = clamp(1 + 0.08 log₂(N/33), 1, 1.35) is identically 1 for every N ≤ 33, so it cannot produce an onset near N_c ≈ 15. Killed by derivation, without a run.

ISOTOPE Ψ. Untestable: the values are unmeasured (contract C3), and there is no resonance law to reproduce.

Chapter 68
The Spectral Gap of the Ring
[MEASURED] λ₂ = 3.250184 exact (multiplicity 4, recomputed 18:45 CT; the QUICK4 summary’s “doubly degenerate” is wrong); normalized L/6 = 0.541697
[UNMEASURED] whether this gap gives any dynamical advantage (specialness tests sealed next, not run)

The canon ring, the Cayley graph of Z₃₃ with jumps {1,10,15}, has Laplacian λ₂ = 3.250184. Taking every one of the 61 non-isomorphic 6-regular circulants on 33 nodes, the canon ring has the largest λ₂, and it is the only one that does; the runner-up is 3.000000. In 200 random 6-regular graphs the largest λ₂ was 2.638. This is a fact about the graph’s connectivity. The tests above show it does not make ignition, seating, wobble or the TE gate any different from random graphs, so it remains description, not mechanism.

Figure XI.5. λ₂ of all 61 circulant classes; canon ring marked (lambda2_circulants.json). · claim=none · measured data only
